title: feat(studio): reference pickers for Action target (flow/page/view)
body:
## Summary

The Action editor's `target` was a free-text field for `flow`/`modal`/`form` types — admins had to know and type exact metadata names. It now resolves against the matching metadata type:

- **useMetaOptions** (new): generic name+label loader for any metadata type (generalises `useObjectOptions`).
- **ActionDefaultInspector**: `flow` → flow picker, `modal` → page picker, `form` → view picker; `url`/`api` stay free text. Out-of-catalog values are preserved as a "(not found)" option so nothing is silently dropped.

## Verification
Verified live: a `flow`-type action's **Flow name** is now a dropdown of the real flows (current target resolved to its label; opening it lists all flows). Full metadata-admin test suite (274) passes.
